chunks: The tablets and the sheet, while he is without wudu (ablution)? He said: “No.”
Then he said, may Allah the Exalted support him: There is no harm in his reciting whatever he wishes from the surahs of the Qur'an, so long as it is between that and seven verses. This indicates it.

key_terms.اَلصَّحِيفَةِ: the sheet or written page on which the Qur'an is written
key_terms.اَلْقُرْآنِ: the Qur'an, the revealed Book of Allah
key_terms.سَبْعِ آيَاتٍ: seven verses, the stated limit in this ruling
key_terms.وُضُوءٍ: ritual ablution required for states of purity

ai.seo_question: Can a person without wudu (ablution) write or recite from the Qur'an?
ai.summary: This passage gives a legal ruling concerning a person without wudu (ablution), indicating that writing the Qur'an in such a state is not permitted. It also states that limited recitation from the Qur'an, up to seven verses, is not objectionable.
